<!--
Use this template if you are an author or a rights holder and want a work
withdrawn, or if a book's recorded license evidence is wrong.

A book's status is frozen at the commit its evidence was read from. When a
license changes upstream, a person reviews it and updates the record. A
withdrawn book becomes reference-only, its text is removed, and the site is
rebuilt without it.

This issue is public. Do not include personal contact details or other
private information. To write privately instead, use the contact details on
the maintainer's GitHub profile: https://github.com/LinnJS
-->

## Kind of concern

<!-- Keep one. -->

- I am the author or a rights holder and ask for withdrawal
- The recorded license evidence is wrong or out of date
- Other rights concern

## Book id or official URL

<!-- The id appears in the README table and in books/<id>/metadata.yaml. -->

## The concern

<!-- What is wrong, and what you are asking the library to do. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Links to the license file, the statement, or the commit that supports the concern. -->
